low.label: SAFE
low.tagline: No obvious scam indicators detected. Stay alert.

medium.label: SUSPICIOUS - BE CAREFUL
medium.tagline: Contains unverified links or urgent wording. Do not send money.

high.label: HIGH RISK - LIKELY SCAM
high.tagline: High probability of fraud. Do not tap any link or share PIN.

critical.label: DANGER - CONFIRMED THREAT
critical.tagline: Active phishing link or known fraud pattern. Stop immediately!

actionState.heading: What did you do?
actionState.prompt: Choose your current situation to see the exact steps to take:

clicked.title: I clicked or entered details
clicked.desc: I opened the link or gave info

reasons.THREAT_OF_BLOCKING: Threatens to block your account, SIM, or electricity
reasons.FAKE_BANK_DOMAIN: Impersonates an official Indian bank domain
reasons.LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN: Uses a lookalike website name mimicking a trusted brand
reasons.SHORTENED_URL: Hides the actual destination behind a short link
reasons.SUSPICIOUS_TLD: Uses a cheap domain extension (.xyz, .top, .site, etc.)
reasons.UPI_COLLECT_REQUEST: Demands an outgoing UPI payment instead of sending money
reasons.ENTER_PIN_TO_RECEIVE: Asks you to enter your UPI PIN to receive money (PIN is ONLY for sending)
reasons.ASKS_FOR_OTP: Asks you to share OTP (Banks NEVER ask for OTP)
reasons.FAKE_KYC_PROMPT: Demands urgent KYC update or PAN card linking
reasons.PRIZE_OR_LOTTERY: Claims you won an unearned prize or lottery
reasons.PARCEL_FEE_REQUEST: Demands courier fee or customs clearance for a fake parcel
reasons.ELECTRICITY_DISCONNECT_THREAT: Threatens power cutoff tonight over unpaid bills
reasons.KNOWN_PHISHING_FEED_MATCH: Matches active cybercrime threat intelligence blacklist
reasons.QR_LEADS_TO_PAYMENT: QR code initiates outgoing payment instead of deposit
reasons.UNKNOWN_SENDER_IMPERSONATION: Impersonates an official officer or bank executive
reasons.EXCESSIVE_PUNYCODE_OR_DIGITS: Uses an IP address or deceptive encoded characters

actions.DO_NOT_CLICK: Do NOT click any link in the message
actions.DO_NOT_REPLY: Do NOT reply or call the given phone number
actions.NEVER_SHARE_OTP_PIN: NEVER share your OTP, password, or UPI PIN with anyone
actions.NO_PIN_TO_RECEIVE: Remember: UPI PIN is ONLY entered to SEND money, NEVER to receive
actions.DECLINE_COLLECT_REQUEST: Open your UPI app and DECLINE / REJECT the collect request immediately
actions.VERIFY_OFFICIAL: Verify by calling the official customer care number on the back of your card
actions.DELETE_AND_BLOCK: Block the sender number and delete the message
actions.INFORM_FAMILY: Tell your children or family members before taking any action
actions.CHANGE_PASSWORD: Change your bank password and reset your UPI PIN immediately
actions.CALL_BANK: Call your bank's 24x7 toll-free helpline to freeze your account/cards
actions.REPORT_1930: Call 1930 IMMEDIATELY (National Cyber Crime Helpline - First 2 Hours Golden Period)
actions.REPORT_PORTAL: File an official complaint at https://cybercrime.gov.in
actions.REPORT_SANCHAR_SAATHI: Report the fraudulent SMS on Sanchar Saathi (Chakshu)
actions.REPORT_IN_APP: Report and block the sender directly in WhatsApp or your SMS app
actions.SAVE_EVIDENCE: Take screenshots of the message, link, and transaction ID as proof
